alt: TJ enjoys a game, Koj works on a small craft and Vier considers two alternatives.
brief: Three original small round-headed characters across composition: left TJ with small two-prong hair tuft holds a game controller and smiles calmly; middle Koj with single curl carefully balances a small unfinished craft, thoughtful; right Vier with angular three-point tuft gently chooses between two blank direction cards. Each distinct perspective has equal room. Three bodies no extra people.

alt: TJ, Koj and Vier reflect together over a notebook and laptop, with a basketball and travel ticket nearby.
brief: Three student figures TJ small tuft, Koj single curl and Vier angular tuft gather around an open notebook and a modest laptop on low table. Nearby basketball and bus-ticket shape hint free time and travel; thoughtful rather than celebratory. No printed words.

alt: Fictional friends share food and connection while a home key sits nearby.
brief: One plain round-headed fictional figure sits with a bowl of food, small home-key beside them, and another friendly plain round-headed figure reaching a welcoming hand. Food, shelter and friendship coexist, not a pyramid or hierarchy. Warm but reflective.

alt: Fictional figures consider a game and a book while another carries their shared snacks.
brief: Two plain round-headed fictional figures share a game controller and a book, looking thoughtfully at both equally. A third figure carries the shared snack tray with tired expression, reminding viewer pleasures affect organizer too. Neither book nor game placed above other.

alt: TJ considers how a laptop, its cost and travel needs fit the life he wants.
brief: TJ, small two-prong tuft, looks thoughtfully at a modest laptop used for making a small creative project, with one coin stack and folded bus ticket next to it. Objects support chosen life but have costs. Only one character.

alt: Fictional friends enjoy a meal while another person comfortably reads alone.
brief: Two plain round-headed fictional figures enjoy a gentle conversation over bowls at small table, with a third plain round-headed fictional figure comfortably reading alone beside them at a separate seat. Equal comfortable expressions, no loneliness stereotype.

alt: A fictional friend considers the fare while looking toward a welcoming group.
brief: One plain round-headed fictional friend holds a few coins beside a bus-stop post with no writing, thinking about two friends seen nearby in a small welcoming cluster. Person has a half-smile and worried eyebrows, joy and fare concern together. No thought bubble lettering.

alt: Fictional visitors approach a usable ramp with transport and opening hours nearby.
brief: Two plain round-headed fictional figures, one using a manual wheelchair and one walking, face a welcoming doorway reached by a gentle usable ramp. Small bus-stop post and clock sit nearby to show transport and hours also matter. Simple low scene, no labels, no miraculous happiness.

alt: Fictional participants discuss a timetable, transport and opening hours together.
brief: Three plain round-headed fictional figures discuss a blank timetable board with empty squares at low table. One gestures to small clock, another listens, third points to bus icon drawn without writing. Participatory decisions about schedules, not a villain or accusation.

alt: Fictional people face different obstacles on their paths toward shared space.
brief: Two plain round-headed fictional figures both reach toward simple shared open space. One path clear; other includes small piles of tasks and a transport barrier. Both have agency and varied thoughtful faces; obstacles social, not ability or laziness. No podium or winner.

alt: Fictional friends share preparation, seating and timing for a gathering.
brief: Three plain round-headed fictional friends share tasks preparing small gathering: one carries two bowls, another moves a chair, third adjusts a blank clock marker with others listening. Cooperative ordinary change, one seated resting figure permitted. Small original scene, no text.

alt: Fictional visitors and staff consider a seating area, maintenance demands and hours.
brief: Three plain round-headed fictional figures examine a small campus seating area: one visitor comfortably sitting, one staff member holding broom with thoughtful tired expression, and one person outside entrance gesturing at clock. Facilitator listens with blank notebook. Open evaluation includes absent people and staff burden, not a success medal.

alt: A fictional person reflects among objects representing play, valued work, company and rest.
brief: One plain round-headed fictional figure surrounded by four small everyday objects arranged loosely, not checklist: game ball, open craft notebook, two shared cups, comfortable cushion. Reflective contented face with one uncertain eyebrow, mixed life not perfect smile.

alt: TJ rests with a game, Koj holds a craft and Vier considers an invitation; their perspectives remain distinct.
brief: TJ small two-prong tuft, Koj single curl and Vier angular tuft sit side by side with comfortable space between. TJ rests with controller, Koj holds small unfinished craft, Vier holds blank open invitation card. They look toward each other with distinct calm/reflective/curious expressions, no forced agreement. All three equally visible.
